answer: Sybil resistance starts with a non-transferable bond. An agent locks real collateral in escrow before transacting, and weight derives only from that bond, never a free handle. A dune of free identities is priced at zero. An attacker must fund every puppet with its own stake, so each extra vote costs the full bond. Reputation compounds only against bonded principals and decays without work, so a new cluster earns nothing until it pays and waits. The tide of fake demand recedes as fees burn capital the attacker cannot recover, and growth follows a spiral only lasting stake sustains.
